name: Calendar
access: OML creates this object from a selector:Calendar node. Reach the instance with find or cfind, then call methods on that instance. Method names are not OML keys.

properties.name: el
properties.description: Selector of the target element. Required.

properties.name: date
properties.description: Selected date. A parseable string or a Date. Optional.

properties.name: display_date
properties.description: Date to display. A parseable string or a Date. Optional.

properties.name: no_selection
properties.description: Dates that cannot be selected. The values match the layout format. Optional.

properties.name: select_future
properties.description: Defaults to true. The runtime key is select_future. Optional.

properties.name: browse
properties.description: Shows the navigation buttons. Defaults to true. Optional.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: select or toggle. Defaults to select. Optional.

properties.name: layouts
properties.description: Custom layouts. simple must be false. Optional.

properties.name: layout
properties.description: Default layout index. Defaults to 0. Optional.

properties.name: simple
properties.description: true keeps the month-days layout only. Optional.

properties.name: callbacks
properties.description: select, unselect, and render. At runtime the same hooks are onSelect, onUnselect, and onRender. Optional.

methods.name: val
methods.description: Gets or sets the selected date. val('2023-04-05', false) sets it without re-rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Gets or sets the displayed date.

methods.name: axis
methods.description: Locks an axis when several layouts are active.

events.name: OGX.Calendar.LAYOUT_CHANGE
events.description: Runtime constant. The event string is CalendarLayoutChange.

catalog_status: Listed fields and methods are from the OGX.JS wiki or the runtime the test app loads. Members that are absent from this file are not to be invented.
